author: Nikkellsson
quote: Catastrophic limitations (both the 30 FPS cap and the game mechanics), blatant abuse from Lucia, a "servant simulator" for a hole—GTA has lost its signature sense of total freedom.There are bugs, but given the recent release, that’s something one can temporarily put up with.There are some great game mechanics that partially distract from what is essentially a slap in the face—and at such a price, too...
